instructions: DeckCraft is a presentation app (a PowerPoint clone). Coordinates are points on the current slide (y down; the default 16:9 slide is 960×540). Every action is a command: find ids and parameters with list_commands and run them with run_command (or several with batch). Typical flow: new_presentation → add_slide {layout:"titleAndContent", title, body} → add_shape / add_text_box / insert_picture / insert_chart → inspect_slide to read back ids, boxes and text → render_slide to look at the result. Shapes are selected with run_command edit.select {ids:[…]}; formatting commands (format.*, shape.fill, shape.line…) act on the selection or on `ids`. Save with save_presentation (.deckcraft or .pptx). Backend: headless (in-process engine; no window). Community: https://discord.gg/artcraft (Discord), https://getartcraft.com/apps/deckcraft (app page), https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft (source). The `app.links` command returns these links.

tools.name: add_shape
tools.description: Insert a preset shape (rect, roundRect, ellipse, triangle, diamond, rightArrow, chevron, star5, heart, cloud, wedgeRectCallout, line, straightConnector1… see shape.presets) at x,y with size w×h, with optional text and fill colour (#RRGGBB or accent1..6).

tools.name: add_slide
tools.description: Insert a slide after the current one with a layout (title, titleAndContent, sectionHeader, twoContent, comparison, titleOnly, blank, contentWithCaption, pictureWithCaption) and optional title/body text (body: one paragraph per line, leading tabs indent).

tools.name: add_text_box
tools.description: Insert a text box. Height grows to fit the text.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run commands in order; stops at the first error unless keepGoing. Returns each result.

tools.name: call_app
tools.description: Call any control-channel method (ui.click, ui.set, ui.dialog.*, ui.inspect…). Desktop app only (`deckcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export slides: png/jpeg (one slide, or all with all:true), pptx, deckcraft, outline text, or pdf (slides, notes pages or handouts).

tools.name: go_to_slide
tools.description: Make a slide current (shape commands act on the current slide).

tools.name: insert_chart
tools.description: Insert a chart (column, bar, line, pie, doughnut, area, scatter, stackedColumn…) with categories and series.

tools.name: insert_picture
tools.description: Insert a picture from a file path or base64 data, optionally at a box.

tools.name: insert_table
tools.description: Insert a table with rows×cols and optional cell text (data: rows of strings).

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.description: Slides (index, id, title, layout, shape count, transition, animations, notes), sections, theme, layouts, media and the selection.

tools.name: inspect_slide
tools.description: One slide's shapes with ids, kinds, boxes [x,y,w,h], placeholder types, text, fills, tables, charts; plus background, transition, animations, notes.

tools.name: key
tools.description: Press a key as on the keyboard: text editing keys (arrows, Backspace, Enter, Tab), nudges, and shortcuts (cmd+B…).

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: Every command (id, label, ribbon/menu place, shortcut, parameter summary, whether it is enabled now). Filter by a substring of id or label.

tools.name: new_presentation
tools.description: Start a new presentation (one title slide). Optional theme: DeckCraft, Harbor, Ember, Meadow, Nocturne, Paper, Coral Reef, Slate.

tools.name: open_presentation
tools.description: Open a .deckcraft or .pptx file by path.

tools.name: pointer
tools.description: Drive the active tool with pointer events in slide points: down/drag/up/move/doubleclick, exactly like the mouse (draws, moves, resizes, rotates, places the caret).

tools.name: render_slide
tools.description: Render a slide to a PNG image and return it, to check your work visually.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run any command by id with JSON parameters. This is how everything is done: slide.new, shape.insert, text.set, format.bold, shape.fill, design.theme, transition.set, animation.add, table.merge, edit.undo…

tools.name: save_presentation
tools.description: Save the active presentation (.deckcraft or .pptx by extension).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot of the whole DeckCraft window (UI included). Desktop app only (`deckcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).

tools.name: select
tools.description: Select shapes by id (formatting commands then act on them).

tools.name: select_tool
tools.description: Pick the pointer tool: select, textBox, shape (with preset), pen, highlighter, eraser — or a preset name.

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Replace a shape's text (keeps its first run's formatting). Leading tabs set bullet levels.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into the text being edited (or into the selected shape).
